command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'python='; python3 --version
printf 'uv='; command -v uv || true
printf 'uvx='; command -v uvx || true
printf 'pip='; python3 -m pip --version 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- disk ---'
df -h "$HOME" /tmp | sed -n '1,3p'
printf '%s\n' '--- pocket artifacts ---'
for p in "$HOME/.cache/uv" "$HOME/.cache/huggingface" "$HOME/.cache/torch" "$HOME/.local/share/omega777-pocket" "/tmp/omega777-pocket"; do if [ -e "$p" ]; then du -sh "$p" 2>/dev/null || true; else echo "missing $p"; fi; done
printf '%s\n' '--- running pocket processes ---'
pgrep -af 'pocket[-_]tts|omega777.*pocket' || true
